title: NRO/NGA Senate and GAO audit over carryover funds

tellings.quote: they underwent a uh, Senate and GAO audit for enormous uh, misappropriation of funds, specifically carryover funds, back in 1994, 1995, uh, in the realm of $3.2 billion or so.

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1994 and 1995 two US spy agencies, the National Reconnaissance Office, which runs spy satellites, and the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency, which studies satellite images and maps, were audited by the Senate and by the Government Accountability Office, Congress's watchdog for spending. He says the audit was over roughly 3.2 billion dollars in misused carryover funds, meaning money left unspent and rolled into later years. He raises it as a sign that large sums could have quietly gone to hidden work.
